trust_services_criteria.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.
The entity implements boundary protection measures to safeguard system components against unauthorized external ingress.
The entity protects data in transmission using encryption technologies.
The entity implements controls to prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious modifications to cloud storage and ledger data.
The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts or vulnerabilities.
